name: BACH_0352
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (84%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Flagged (tier 2) because invasive carcinoma (12%) is in the conformal set [F1] and image reliability is low [F6].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 84%, Invasive 12%, Benign 4%, Normal 0% | Favors InSitu; 12% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive (10% alpha; 90% dataset coverage) | Cannot exclude invasive carcinoma |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.30 (flagged); 100th percentile OOD (12/12 regions) | Suspect, atypical input image |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Independent backbones disagree on top |
| Similar cases | 2/5 InSitu (40%) [F5]: 2 Benign, 2 InSitu, 1 Invasive | Mixed Benign, InSitu, Invasive neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.128, contribution +0.626); 0/20 AI spot-check [F2] · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 1) · context · Below-typical score (-0.134, contribution +0.604); 8/20 AI spot-check [F3] · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 2) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (0.081, contribution -0.474); 19/20 AI spot-check [F4] · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.078, contribution +0.457); 20/20 AI spot-check · Validated
- **HoVer-Net tumor cellularity** (regions 2, 6, 11) · context · 91% tumor cells [F7], 5092/mm² [F8], 50 µm² nuclei (10th percentile) [F9] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion diff +0.0008, 95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064); top driver normal_lobules (+0.626) is Unreliable (0/20 spot-check).

## Could be wrong if
- Stromal invasion exists in high-risk regions 11 (50% risk), 2 (21%), or 6 (17%), making this Invasive.
- Out-of-distribution image quality (reliability 0.30) or Benign mimicry (closest neighbor BACH_0330, 81% similarity) misleads the model.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 11, 2, 6**: Highest invasive risk (50%, 21%, 17%) and dense tumor cellularity; inspect stroma for invasion.
2. **Regions 3, 6, 8**: Strongest duct-confined scores; consider drafted p63, calponin, and ER stains to verify InSitu.
3. **Regions 0–11**: Flagged low reliability (0.30); check for artifact and consider drafted recut H&E or deeper levels.
